questions.question: Open review threads block ~12 PRs. How should I handle them?

options.label: Fix bot, ask on human (Recommended)
options.description: Fix real bot findings in code, reply+resolve bot nits. Leave human threads for you and list them.

options.label: Fix all findings
options.description: Treat every thread (bot and human) as a request, fix in code, then resolve.

options.label: Defer all, resolve
options.description: Reply 'deferred' on each thread and resolve it so the PRs can merge now.

questions.question: 8 Invoker PRs change zero files (#12976-80, #12925-26, #13071). What should I do with them?

options.label: Close as superseded (Recommended)
options.description: Check each has no content vs master first, then close; retarget any child PR onto the real base.

options.label: Leave them open
options.description: Skip them; report them as not landable.

questions.question: ~22 PRs need rebases or test fixes. Where should that work run?

options.label: Here, one at a time (Recommended)
options.description: I rebase/fix and force-push each branch myself, requeue it, and keep watching until the queue drains. Slow (hours) but you see every step.

options.label: Invoker workflows
options.description: Submit one fix workflow per stuck PR to Invoker; I watch and requeue. Faster in parallel, but more moving parts.
